ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (23) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Attributions follow the print (Amiel, Seneca, Thoreau). «Баба» (baba, 'peasant woman') is rendered 'a peasant woman'; in Amiel «начало» (nachalo) means 'beginning', and in Seneca «воспитание» (vospitanie, 'upbringing') and «свободные науки» (svobodnye nauki, 'liberal sciences') are kept literal, as is the printed period after his question.
Source observation: [18] «рассеевает» is a one-letter slip for «рассеивает» (rasseivaet, 'distracts'); translated in that sense
